newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills rises to 5.76 pct.
newsitem.headline: Rate on 91-day Bahrain t-bills rises to 5.76 pct.

text.p: The average yield at this week's tender for 10 million dinars of 91-day Bahrain treasury bills rose to 5.76 percent from 5.69 percent last week, a spokeswoman for the Bahrain Monetary Agency said on Monday.
The average price fell to 98.565 from 98.582 last week and the minimum price accepted was 98.553.
Banks submitted bids for 16.76 million dinars worth of bills, down from 21.82 million dinars a week ago.
The bills, maturing on October 22, were offered on Monday and will be issued on Wednesday.
